_doc: Battlefield geometry (world units, world = 1170 x 540; x grows to the right, enemies come from x < 0) and combat timings. frontlineX = share of world width where the frontline hero stands.

melee._doc: The frontline hits the foremost enemy with x in (frontX-reachFar, frontX-reachNear). Blocking enemies stop at frontX-standOff-formationX.

spikes._doc: Spikes hurt enemies with x in [frontX-212, frontX-156].

simulation._doc: At speed > 1 the frame time is split into fixed 1/60 s steps; a frame never advances more than maxFrameDelta x speed.
